# Sharma & Sharma Intellectual Property Attorneys (IPMARK)

> Established in 1972, Sharma & Sharma (IPMARK) is one of India's legacy Intellectual Property law firms, safeguarding trademarks, copyrights, industrial designs, and global brand portfolios.

## Primary Practice Areas & Landing Pages

- [Trademark Registration in India](https://ipmark.in/trademark-registration-india): End-to-end statutory trademark availability search, Nice classification, filing, office action defense, and registration certificate issuance for domestic, US, Chinese, and global entities.
- [Trademark Attorney & Lawyer in India](https://ipmark.in/trademark-attorney-india): Specialized legal counsel, examination show-cause defense, opposition prosecution, and High Court IP litigation.
- [Trademark Agent in India](https://ipmark.in/trademark-agent-india): Registered statutory agency under Section 145 of the Trade Marks Act 1999, Form TM-M Power of Attorney handling, and registry docketing.
- [WIPO Madrid Protocol India](https://ipmark.in/madrid-protocol-india): International trademark extension filings across 150+ member countries.
- [Copyright Registration India](https://ipmark.in/copyright-registration-india): Software source code, SaaS algorithms, literary works, and artistic logo protection under the Copyright Act 1957.
- [Industrial Design Registration India](https://ipmark.in/design-registration-india): 15-year statutory aesthetic product design protection before the Indian Patent Office.
